title: Design System: sintr website
scope: Public website only (site/). The product data model is documented in docs/DESIGN.md.

headline-statement.purpose: Two-tone statements; second clause in Soft Ink.

headline.purpose: Section heads; XL variant clamps up to 5rem.

title.purpose: Day headings, opened by an italic Ink Three time of day inside the sentence.

body.purpose: Prose at max 36em in Ink Two; 1rem under 720px.

document.purpose: Serif body of the report paper.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav, tabs, segmented options. Sentence case.

file-body.purpose: Contents of real files and shell commands only.

file-path.purpose: Path captions of real files only.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Default file cards resting in the light.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: The hero file and the report paper.

shadows.name: button-ink-rest
shadows.purpose: Contact shadow under the ink pill at rest.

shadows.name: button-ink-hover
shadows.purpose: Warm glow rising under the ink pill on hover, with a 1px lift.

shadows.name: paper-ring
shadows.purpose: Knocks gate dots out of the line they sit on (5px on the stations gate).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Expo-out for interface transitions, reveals and the highlighter.

motion.name: ease-slow
motion.purpose: Slow in-out for the window light.

motion.name: light-recolor
motion.purpose: Cross-fade of --l1, --l2, --l3, --leaf (registered @property colors) on time-of-day change.

motion.name: light-move
motion.purpose: The window pane travels to where the section's light falls.

motion.name: light-enter-breathe
motion.value: sun-enter 2.8s; sun-breathe 11s ease-in-out infinite alternate (opacity 1 to .84)

motion.name: leaf-sway
motion.purpose: Leaf shadows move in the window light.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 1.3s, transform 1.4s (16px), filter 1.3s (blur 5px) var(--ease); stagger 0.09s, max 6
motion.purpose: Content settles in once on entering the viewport.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.value: rise 1.5s var(--ease), children delayed 0, .18s, .34s, .48s; hero file settle 1.9s at .7s

motion.name: write
motion.value: line opacity .9s, delay i*150ms + 200ms; highlighter 1.4s at 1.35s
motion.purpose: The capture entry writes itself, then the quoted thought is highlighted.

motion.name: tab-underline
motion.purpose: Selected tab underline grows from the left.

motion.name: parallax
motion.purpose: Artifacts drift slightly slower than the words.

motion.name: opt-in
motion.purpose: Content is visible by default; reduced motion removes animation and transitions.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Hero copy to 8 columns; flow may wrap.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: All splits single-column, sticky released, flow turns vertical; parallax off at or below.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Body 1rem, 72px header with GitHub mark and Install pill only, fixed oversized light, lists stack.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Consulting-Room Wall"**

The page is the white wall of a quiet consulting room, and window light crosses it while the week between two sessions goes by. The ground is plaster white, everything structural is graphite ink and hairline, and the only color in the world is light: a tall, obliquely projected window of soft gradient with blurred sage leaf shadows, multiplied onto the page. As the reader moves through the week, the light changes time of day (morning, noon, dusk, early morning, evening, golden hour, night, late morning, dawn) and cross-fades rather than jumps.

Hierarchy is carried by type size and line breaks alone. A light, optically sized serif speaks at display size in two tones; a quiet grotesk does the reading; a mono appears only where a real file is being shown. The product is demonstrated, not illustrated: every artifact on the page is a real sintr file format, set as selectable text in a white paper card labelled by its path, resting in the light.

Density is low and the pace is slow. Sections are separated by large vertical rests and single hairlines, not by fills or boxes. Motion is opt-in and unhurried: the light moves over about three seconds, leaves sway on 13 and 17 second cycles, and content settles in with a short blur-to-sharp fade. With JavaScript off or reduced motion requested, the light rests at the top of the page and everything reads. The wellness-app default (pastel blob hero, phone mockup, feature-card trio) and the dev-tool default (dark terminal page) are both rejected.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, graphite ink, black pill controls; light is the only color.
Light serif display (weight 300) carrying hierarchy by size and two tones, never by labels.
Real files as artifacts: white cards, hairline edge, path as caption, mono body.
Hairline-ruled structure on a 12-column grid with generous section rests.
A time-of-day light that moves with the reader, and that disappears into a static wash when motion is unwelcome.

rules.name: The Light Is the Only Color Rule
rules.body: Chroma lives in the window light and nowhere else. Gradients never fill text, buttons or cards; the light is a projection on the wall, multiplied onto whatever it falls across.

rules.name: The Morning Wash Exception
rules.body: Exactly one surface carries a faint light gradient as a fill: the install prompt card that asks the visitor to act (162deg, #e9f2f8 to #f3f2ee to #f9ebe1). One per page, and only on the single call to act.

rules.name: The Verbatim Rule
rules.body: Peach highlights a person's own words. If the words are not a quotation of the person, they do not get the highlighter.

rules.name: The Size Is the Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Rank is expressed by size, weight 300 serif, and line breaks. No eyebrows, kickers, uppercase labels or icon tiles introduce a heading; context belongs inside the heading sentence.

rules.name: The Mono Means File Rule
rules.body: Fragment Mono appears only for real file contents, paths, and shell commands. It never decorates a heading or signals "technical".

rules.name: The Held Wall Rule
rules.body: The first viewport keeps one wall region empty so the light has somewhere to land. Do not fill the upper right of the hero.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: A new surface gets a 1px hairline before it gets a shadow. Shadows are reserved for real artifacts resting in the light; the file listing in the privacy section deliberately drops its shadow.

dos: **Do** keep every filled control Graphite Ink on white, as a full pill; selected states are ink too.
**Do** show real file formats as selectable text in a white, hairline-edged card captioned with the file's path.
**Do** carry hierarchy with light serif size steps and line breaks, putting context (like the time of day) inside the heading sentence.
**Do** keep small text at Ink Three (#6b6e75) or darker; reserve Soft Ink for large type and marks.
**Do** separate sections with large rests and a single hairline rather than fills.
**Do** make motion opt-in and keep every interaction (toggles, tabs) working with JavaScript off.
**Do** self-host every font and asset; the site loads nothing from third parties.
donts: **Don't** fill text, buttons or cards with gradient; chroma belongs to the window light (including the small window in the brand glyph), plus the single morning-wash install card.
**Don't** add eyebrows, kickers, uppercase labels, or icon tiles above headings.
**Don't** use the mono face outside real file contents, paths and commands.
**Don't** use the peach highlighter on anything but a person's own quoted words.
**Don't** build the page from pastel blobs, a phone mockup, or a row of three feature cards, and don't turn it into a dark terminal page.

**Don't** use glassmorphism or backdrop blur on surfaces; blur belongs only to the light's soft edges, the leaf shadows, and the reveal transition. No purple-to-blue pairs; lavender appears only as evening light mixed with peach.
